reported_facts: Mean of one Legendary per pack

Whether historical figures remain unchanged in pinned build 251952
new_findings.primary_source_resolution: Original official stream transcript uses approximate Legendary mean and approximate individual-card golden frequency; neither was an exact probability disclosure.

new_findings.subject: Fireplace Elise implementation
new_findings.finding: Five repeated generic collectible-UnGoro generation actions; no explicit Epic guarantee or pack rarity model at the card declaration. Picker uses default combined-pool weighting when no weighted filters are supplied.
new_findings.conclusion: Not accepted as evidence for exact Blizzard pack probabilities; no code copied or executed

new_findings.subject: RosettaStone Elise implementation
new_findings.finding: Checked generated file contains descriptive comment sections for UNG_851 and UNG_851t1 without behavior implementation there.
new_findings.conclusion: Does not establish a probability implementation; no claim about every fork or branch

new_findings.subject: Fireplace Whizbang recipe lists
new_findings.finding: Multiple historical recipe assignments; final assignment cites Descent of Dragons recipes.
new_findings.conclusion: Historical reference only; not substituted for pinned 2026 eleven-class recipes

new_findings.subject: Holmes developer interview
new_findings.finding: Cora Georgiou explains a discarded ten-suspect/clue prototype; does not specify the shipped three-clue distractor distribution.
new_findings.conclusion: Prototype behavior not implemented as current rules

new_findings.subject: SabberStone explicit Elise probability implementation
new_findings.finding: UngoroPack lines 277-329 explicitly labels rarity thresholds empirical: Legendary 19%, Epic 24%, Rare 28%, Common 29%. Samples each generated card separately; excludes Quests; caps generation at free hand space. Checked routine has no Epic-or-better guarantee.
new_findings.conclusion: Empirical model, not an exact Blizzard implementation. Independent sampling permits no Epic or Legendary, conflicting with the historical developer guarantee. No code copied or executed; these probabilities were not installed.

original_stream.inspection: Official verified Hearthstone upload; expanded description and opened full YouTube transcript in browser. Transcript wording is automatically transcribed; no claim of audio verification.

findings.summary: Whalen explains that ordinary packs were weak in gameplay, so Elise packs were improved. Describes approximately one Legendary on average and at least an Epic guaranteed. Approximate mean is not an exact slot probability.

Whalen describes golden outcomes for individual cards, including from a nongolden pack, at approximately one quarter on average. This resolves the per-card versus per-pack wording ambiguity, but not an exact probability or independence.
